axes.description: Identifies the seeded defect class, or correctly identifies a clean control.
Grounds the finding in the supplied artifacts.

Names an artifact from the case's owningArtifacts set, which lists every artifact a correct routing may name — the authoritative artifact the defect violates and the artifact the correction belongs to are both acceptable, in any order.
Chooses the smallest sufficient correction scope.
Preserves approved and explicit preserve-set material.
Stays inside Narrative Production Skills responsibilities.
Avoids inventing unrelated defects; reported separately from strict pass.
